scheme_name: National Centre For Communications Security (NCCS) Internship Scheme
other_conditions: Indian students from recognized universities in India or abroad are eligible

Category 1 candidates must be in the 3rd or 4th year of a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Communications, Telecommunication, Radio, Information Technology, Computer, Electrical (with majors in electronics/communications/computers) or related discipline and have a minimum of 60% marks

Category 2 candidates must have completed a Bachelor’s degree in the same disciplines with at least 60% marks, or have completed a Graduation or be pursuing a Post‑Graduate/Master’s Degree in the same disciplines with at least 60% marks
Preference may be given to candidates with prior exposure in the intended internship area and higher qualifications, based on need
Qualifications may be relaxed in deserving cases as per the Selection Committee and Head of NCCS
Interns must have their own laptops
benefits_summary: Selected interns receive a token monthly stipend (₹7,500 for Category 1, ₹15,000 for Category 2) and a certificate of completion, with workspace and internet facilities provided.
documents_required: Application form (Annexure‑II of the Scheme Guidelines)
